defects_fixed.name: False-green inventory aggregate
defects_fixed.description: Overall inventory status now depends on host evidence, every required service process identity, service readiness, and manager ownership. Stale or missing service identity and uncertain ownership prevent overall VERIFIED; verified identity and ownership with unverified readiness remain UNKNOWN.

evidence.detail: Separates hostStatus and serviceStatus and computes the aggregate inventory status.
Successful host observations plus stale service identity are not overall VERIFIED.
Missing service identity is not overall VERIFIED and readiness remains UNKNOWN when a listener is observed.

defects_fixed.name: Missing manager-handoff preflight contract
defects_fixed.description: The collector now implements _manager_handoff_status and returns the documented managerHandoff field. It is explicitly a blocked/uncertain preflight only; eligible is always false because manager-to-manager handoff is not implemented.

evidence.detail: Computes fixed handoff-preflight states and never authorizes transfer.
Includes managerHandoff in every successful collector inventory.
Checks the exact documented response field set and non-eligibility.
Documents the blocked/uncertain contract and absence of a supported transfer.

manager_handoff_contract.limitations: OWNERSHIP_VERIFIED describes observed ownership evidence only; it does not mean transfer is supported.

Adds deterministic aggregate, readiness, ownership ambiguity, and manager-record non-mutation tests.
Checks response contract and unauthenticated operational request rejection.
